description.narrative: PIL DB MOUNGODE Girls who have dropped out of school are a major concern for every family. Because of their vulnerability to poverty, young girls who are not married off at an early age are forced to become street vendors of the products their mothers force them to sell. Subject to vagrancy, unwanted pregnancies are a common occurrence, plunging the young girl further into distress and rejection. Girls married at 15 or 16 have problems giving birth, and in most cases are divorced by their husbands, resulting in a large number of young divorced brides with 1 or 2 children. The Gamou Kazoé commune, one of the areas with the highest birth rate and young population with a high percentage of young girls (RGPH 2012), faces this recurring problem.It is in thiscontext that we present through this microproject a strategy that will ensure the empowerment of 280 young girls from the most populated neighborhoods with a high concentration of out-of-school, unschooled and divorced young girls, training them in citizenship, civic-mindedness, protection of human rights and remedies in the event of violation.2. Overall objectiveEnsure a better future for 280 girls from vulnerable families in Gamou by creating permanent centers for girl protection and income-generating activities to ensure their empowerment.3. Specific objectives Create 14 permanent centers for the protection of young girlsCapacity-building for 280 girls on citizenship, civic-mindedness, human rights protection and remedies in the event of violation, and setting up IGA centers in the 14 districts of the Gamou commune (KAZOE).Ensure the economic empowerment of 280 young girls in the commune.4. Methodology  Target 20 girls per district Identification of sites for the creation of protection centers for young girls Capacity-building on citizenship, civic-mindedness, protection of human rights and means of redress in the event of violation, and establishment of IGA centers in the 14 neighborhoods of the Gamou commune (KAZOE). AGR training (sewing, cosmetics, agri-food processing, catering, chair weaving, Mak-up traditional andmodern braiding) Training in entrepreneurship, marketing and business management Distribution of IGA support kits Support for formalization as a cooperative society (obtaining Mairie approval) Training of women human rights protection coach leaders by district on human rights, GBV and remedies. Coaching with local follow-up for 6 months to support them in marketing, product commercialization and financial management (2 months of follow-up during the project and 4 months after the project) by the NGO PIL-DB. Set up 14 SMCs whose members are young girls Trained3. expected results- 14 safe spaces for girls' protection and income-generating activities to ensure their empowerment are created in Gamou.- 280 girls are trained in citizenship, civic-mindedness, human rights protection and remedies in the event of violation. - 280 girls are trained in income-generating activities that will enable them to support themselves and their families.- 280 girls are provided with KIT AGR working capital to ensure the sustainability of their activities.- Women leaders coached in human rights and girl protection are trained to protect and defend girls in the event of GBV of any kind. - 14 SMCs,whose members are trained girls Trained to better manage resources- Young girls in each neighborhood are organized into simplified cooperatives trained in marketing entrepreneurship to improve management and enable them to benefit from support from otherpartners (MFIs, Chamber of Commerce, CRA, CMANI.....).- Young girls are made aware of reproductive health, thus avoiding unwanted pregnancies and good attendance at health centers once married.- Young girls are made aware of the remedies available to them in theevent of gender-based violations, and know their rights.

participating-org.narrative: L’ONG PIL DB MOUNGODE Contact 96 06 22 79 est une organisation créée à Zinder le Novembre 2012 par arrêté 782/MISPDARDGAPJ/DLP sous l’initiative d’un groupe de personnes soucieux du bien-être des personnes vulnérables surtout les femmes et les enfants dans lebut de contribuer à améliorer de manière durable les modes et moyens d’existence des populations pauvre de la zone. L’ONG a son siège au 3e Arrondissement de la ville de Zinder et sa zone d’intervention couvre toute l’étendue du territoire national. Les domaines d’intervention sont : la Sécurité Alimentaire, Accès aux services sociaux de base, Environnement, Micro finances, Gouvernance locale, Promotion des femmes aux actions de développement, Renforcement des capacités, Suivi et Evaluation des actions de développement initiées par les organisations à la base. L’ONG a pour instances dirigeantes : l’Assemblée Générale, le Bureau Exécutif, le Comité de Contrôle et le Conseil Consultatif Appartenance à la Chambre des ONG et Associations de la région de Zinder, au réseau des opérateurs de formation FAFPA. L’ONG PIL DB a un budget annuel de Vingt-cinq million (25 000 000 ) de FCFA
